title: Link collection
purpose: Govern a specimen collection under this study.

items.label: Collection
items.description: Required. Active collections that no study governs at present.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the study's history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

From now on the collection's specimens, including those already stored, are governed by this study's consent basis. A refusal or withdrawal a participant recorded under a study that governed the collection before still blocks distribution of their specimens, whatever this study's basis. A collection already governed by another study is refused: end that link first. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
